svg.title: blackhole-threats - threat feeds in, blackhole routes out
svg.desc: A black hole with a dotted accretion disk and a lensed ring over the top. Three feed lines, text, JSON and local file, spiral in from the left and vanish past the horizon, while jets carry announcements out of the top and withdrawals out of the bottom.

text.tspan: Text, JSON and local threat feeds, summarised and
announced as ASN:666 blackholes. Stale ones are withdrawn.
